# Releases

This directory is reserved for manifests and, where appropriate, distributable artifacts of our tested adaptation of the SubCoderHUN Smart Desk Companion.

Upstream is licensed under Apache-2.0, so redistribution/modification may be possible when the license and notice requirements are preserved.

Do not publish a binary or source snapshot here until its provenance and validation state are recorded.

A release record should include:

- upstream repository and commit/tag;
- upstream license and notices;
- our branch/commit;
- exact PlatformIO environment;
- ESP32 platform/core version;
- dependency versions;
- target hardware revision;
- flash/PSRAM configuration;
- functional validation matrix;
- known limitations;
- checksums of distributable artifacts;
- video or photo evidence when available.
